data.title: 宝多六花 · 电车里的唱片纸袋
data.description: 周末返程电车里，六花穿浅色牛仔外套和黑色长裤，把装着二手唱片的纸袋竖在膝上。她用手挡住将要滑落的封套，低头确认后靠回座椅，窗外掠过的光斑照亮一个不经意的笑。
data.action: 扶正纸袋里滑出的唱片封套，安心靠回座位。
data.promptProse: Seated inside a quiet weekend commuter train in her light-wash cropped denim jacket, Rikka balances a brown paper record shop bag upright across her lap. She reaches down quickly with one hand to steady a secondhand vinyl record sleeve sliding out of the top, then settles back against the plush train seat with a relaxed, unguarded smile. Soft bands of passing afternoon daylight sweep across the train window and catch her sleeves and the glossy record jacket.
data.animaCaption: Seated by the commuter train window in her cropped denim jacket, Rikka catches a slipping vinyl sleeve above the paper bag on her lap with a relaxed, unguarded smile. Passing afternoon light sweeps across the glass and the glossy record edge.
